limitations: No real provider was contacted. Acceptance of reasoning effort low under required parameters, presence of usage cost and token counts, the returned model string, finish_reason values and own-key routing are confirmed only by the first paid receipt; a mismatch stops the campaign with one preparation reservation charged.

The audit receipt mechanism is two unsigned JSON files. It is integrity evidence against accident, not a security boundary: a consistent hand-written pair, or direct use of the low-level client, reaches the transport.

Tests noticed 10 of 27 guard removals at f305d87; every guard was reproduced working, but most are not protected against later edits. Three regression tests were added at the reviewed commit and were not re-audited by mutation.

The full guard, budget and crash audit ran at f305d87. The reviewed commit differs in protocol text, the fidelity table, a revision record and tests; production code hashes are identical, verified by comparing the two execution freezes.
Headroom is checked, not reserved in the ledger: another spender on the shared phase ledger during the run would trip the per-call preflight.
Not covered until they exist: the real prose artifact, the real prose generation prompt, the prose fidelity table.
Fidelity flags are reviewer outputs and the adjudication is a model reading; neither is ground truth. Reviewer independence is declared, not evidenced.
Four of five sources are abstracts; one preparation draw per representation; results will concern these two artifacts, this benchmark and these two decoders only.
